messages:
ci-bot: Nightly eval finished for branch: release/llama3-v2-quant
ci-bot: Summary: quantized q5f+prefetch build. 'summarize-news' prompt set fail rate: 2.1% -> 14.7% (since last green). Example bad generations attached. https://ci.internal/reports/223456

sophia: whoa. saw alerts on dashboards too — latency fine but quality tanked on a couple of prompt families. Noted correlated to a runtime PR that landed last night.

liam: I pulled a few sample diffs. Most errors look like truncated or repeated sentence tails, occasional improbable token like "thethe". Also higher entropy variance on top tokens.

raj: last night's PR 5487 changed prefetch/kv handshake timing in the serving runtime (reorder prefetch -> kvcache attach). Suspect edge case where kv length != expected for prefix handoff; could perturb softmax inputs when quantized.

maria: can we get a reproducible failing case? I can run a local canary with q5f and the new runtime. If it's handshake timing, a deterministic replay should fail.

liam: repro steps (ran locally, short run):
```
# reproduce snippet
export MODEL=llama3-v2-q5f
export RUNTIME=canary-prefetch-handshake
python infra/replay_eval.py --prompt-set summarize-news --seed 42 --limit 50
```
logs show repeated attention key length warning: "kv_cache_len mismatch: expected 128 got 0" before the bad generation.

john: hmm kv mismatch warning is new. We changed the async prefetch to kick off earlier; if the quantized attention path assumes a filled prefix it may underflow some scaling accumulator. q5f's fused-softmax path has narrower head precision.

neal: I ran the same replay on the previous runtime (master before 5487) + q5f -> no failures. So change is likely runtime-driven, not model weights.

sophia: OK timeline: revert or hotfix? Can we patch the handshake to block until kv attach completes or add a defensive fallback in fused-softmax to use restored FP32 path when kv length is zero? Which is faster to ship?

raj: quick mitigation: add a guard where if kv_cache_len==0 and prefix_len>0, force non-quantized softmax fallback for that request. Patch is small in runtime and low-risk. I'll open PR.

maria: I'll start a targeted canary with that guard + q5f on dedicated canaries and re-run the nightly prompt set.

liam: adding logs to surface when fallback happens (minimal perf cost) so we can correlate. snippet of proposed guard:
```
if prefix_len > 0 and kv_cache_len == 0:
    use_fallback_softmax = True
else:
    use_fallback_softmax = False
```

ops-bot: deploy job queued: runtime-canary/guard-fallback -> staging (pool: canary-2gpu). deploy started at 2026-03-20T09:12:30Z.

ci-bot: re-run queued for prompt-set summarize-news with 100 samples after deploy.

john: long-term we should also validate quantized fused-softmax stability with zero-length kv inputs in unit tests and add a replayed fuzz harness. I'll add tests to eng-runtime test suite.

neal: agree — tests plus a perf-slim guard. If guard false-positive rate is low, we can keep it until a more elegant kernel fix lands.

sophia: thanks all. Action items: raj -> PR for guard (urgent), maria -> canary run + results, john -> add unit/fuzz tests, liam -> attach failing generations to the ticket. We'll reconvene after the canary. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: canary finished: rerun 100 samples -> fail rate dropped back to 2.5% (within noise). Full nightly will run overnight. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/223456-canary

sophia: excellent. keep an eye on overnight full. I'll draft a short postmortem blurb in incidents if it doesn't stabilize.

maria: saving reproducer + logs to ticket INF-874. linking in thread.

liam: attaching representative bad gen for context: "The president said thethe issue was..." (shows duplicated subtoken).

raj: PR opened: runtime#5510 - guard fallback for zero kv-length during prefix handoff. Marking for hotfix backport.

ops-bot: backport job queued to release/llama3-v2-quant.

sophia: thanks. closing provisional triage — leave open until full nightly green.
